WITH RECURSIVE assigned_menu AS ( SELECT DISTINCT m.id FROM sys_user u INNER JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.user_id = u.id AND ur.deleted_at = 0 INNER JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id AND r.status = 1 AND r.deleted_at = 0 INNER JOIN sys_role_menu rm ON rm.role_id = r.id AND rm.deleted_at = 0 INNER JOIN sys_menu m ON m.id = rm.menu_id AND m.status = 1 AND m.deleted_at = 0 WHERE u.id = #{userId} AND u.status = 1 AND u.deleted_at = 0 UNION SELECT m.id FROM sys_menu m WHERE m.status = 1 AND m.deleted_at = 0 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys_user u WHERE u.id = #{userId} AND u.is_super_admin = 1 AND u.status = 1 AND u.deleted_at = 0 ) ), authorized_tree AS ( SELECT m.* FROM sys_menu m INNER JOIN assigned_menu assigned ON assigned.id = m.id WHERE m.status = 1 AND m.deleted_at = 0 UNION DISTINCT SELECT parent.* FROM sys_menu parent INNER JOIN authorized_tree child ON child.parent_id = parent.id WHERE parent.status = 1 AND parent.deleted_at = 0 ) SELECT DISTINCT FROM authorized_tree WHERE menu_type IN (1, 2) ORDER BY sort_order, id
